items.name: Urg the Hacker
items.text: Urg the Hacker — The Orc Age: 30 Race: Orc Occupation: Web Designer Employer: Amazin' E-Commerce Bio: Urg was bullied a lot as a kid for his scrawny stature. He was not your typical brutish Orc. As a child, he turned to the dark web for comfort and found his home among the other outcasts of society. He enjoys using his technical skills to punish the strong who bully the weak. Rejecting the status quo, he wants to change the public perception of Orcs in society. His desire to show his race in a better light brought him on the show. He hopes that his illegal dark web activities won't be discovered by the public. Interests / Hobbies: Manages an NFT marketplace based on funny pictures of the Orcs that used to bully him as a child. Hacking greedy corporate websites like a modern day Robin Hood. Money laundering using dark web cryptocurrencies. Is an audiophile snob and only uses the best headphones.

items.name: Beatrice Cavendish
items.text: Beatrice Cavendish — The Cockatrice Age: 26 Race: Cockatrice Occupation: Optometrist Employer: Cavendish Optometry Bio: Cockatrices can kill people with just one look according to folk legend. Afraid of testing that theory, Beatrice wears special designer sunglasses all the time. Beatrice also designs special lenses for other Cockatrices, allowing them to look in the mirror without harm. Born and raised in England, Beatrice has no arms but possesses a very dexterous beak and legs. Beatrice has no memory of parents, but legend says Cockatrices are born when a rooster's egg is incubated by a snake. Interests / Hobbies: Veganism but still eats meat on rare occasion. Trying on various sunglasses for fun when shopping. Reading about the various written characters, letters, and types used in other languages. Artistic yo-yoing.

items.name: Tsukasa Shōbō
items.text: Tsukasa Shōbō — The Elf Age: 19 Race: Elf Occupation: Aspiring Firefighter Employer: None Bio: An Elf of Japanese descent, Tsukasa has physically stopped growing as most elves do around his age. However, he still has a very immature personality and low emotional intelligence. He moved to the big city from his tiny village in the forest in pursuit of something more exciting. Tsukasa aspires to be a forest firefighter like many of his hometown Elf friends. He has never had a girlfriend and his friends never let him forget that. Therefore, he desperately craves the positive affirmations of a romantic partner. Interests / Hobbies: Learning how to play the guitar. Skateboarding and surfing. Singing and dancing when alone. Working out and exercising, but only when others are watching. Pretty much anything that might make him seem more attractive and desirable. Urban exploration—discovering hidden gems in the city.

items.name: Köttr, The Grumpy
items.text: Köttr, The Grumpy — The Dragon Age: 121 Race: Dragon Occupation: Courier Employer: Dragon Delivery Bio: Dragons reach adulthood around age 100. They can also freely change their own body size at will—ranging from a small house cat to a large four story building. However, changing sizes requires a great deal of energy and strength. Köttr is very lazy and likes to lounge a lot, much like a cat. Sometimes chases their own tail out of boredom or as a form of light exercise when not working and delivering packages. "Works to live" not "lives to work." Doesn't get along with workaholics. Interests / Hobbies: Chilling. Lounging. Basking. Stretching. Meditating. Daydreaming. Resting. Relaxing. Sunbathing. Unwinding. Loafing. Lazing. Reclining. Recharging. Existing. Decompressing.

items.name: Lydia Grimsbane
items.text: Lydia Grimsbane — The Witch Age: 19 Race: Human Occupation: Student Employer: Mismonia Academy of Witchcraft for Young Aspiring Witches Bio: Lydia is a second-year witch at the Mismonia Academy of Witchcraft for Young Aspiring Witches. Lydia hopes to major in Potions and Mixology in order to help creatures with her magical concoctions when she graduates. She also hopes to improve the public image of witches. Lydia has magical rune sleeves tattooed on both of her arms. She doesn't like wearing long sleeve shirts that may cover her tattoos. She prefers a stylish bucket hat over the more traditional witch's hat. Her unique style often draws attention wherever she goes. Interests / Hobbies: Reading. Especially fictional books about a parallel world dominated by humans. Making mocktails with exotic ingredients. Non-alcoholic only. Fitness. Particularly bodyweight exercises like yoga or pilates. Serving fancy tea to groups of friends.

items.name: Ahxi Raanee
items.text: Ahxi Raanee — The Basilisk Age: 28 Race: Basilisk Occupation: Lab Technician Employer: Serpent Science Lab Bio: Basilisks are known to be extremely venomous to the point where even a mere whiff of their poison can send victims into a deep coma. Therefore, their venom is a highly sought-after commodity in the underground markets. Despite the notoriety of Basilisks in society, Ahxi wants to help develop new anti-venoms and chemical products using the potency of the Basilisk venom. Ahxi also decided to come on the show with hopes of improving the public perception of Basilisks and to find allies in this mission. Interests / Hobbies: CrossFit and high-intensity interval training. Pole dancing and rhythmic exercises. Listening to nature sounds. Cannot stand loud noises or loud people. Learning how to code and build hobby websites. Wants to make an app to keep track of various exercise routines and physical goals. Sculpting. Both clay and body.

items.name: Ogark Chestmaul
items.text: Ogark Chestmaul — The Ogre Age: 22 Race: Ogre Occupation: Part-time Bouncer Employer: Local nightclubs and bars. Anywhere that pays. Bio: Ogark lost his left hand in a bet when he was a teenager hanging out with the wrong crowd. He has since cut all ties with that group of "friends." For each time he almost relapsed back into that crowd, he got a tattoo right above his amputated hand to remind him of the accident. Ogark is a bit dumb but means very well. He is extremely well loved by anyone who has met him. A big gentle Giant who would do anything for the people he loves. He loves, he protects, but most importantly, he yells to protect the things he loves. Interests / Hobbies: Bird watching. Despite having a hard time sneaking up on birds. Likes wearing colors that clash against his bluish skin. Despite it making him stick out like a sore thumb when bird watching. Wheel pottery. Despite having just one arm and being extremely clumsy. Yelling loudly.

items.name: Anna Salandria Westergaard
items.text: Anna Salandria Westergaard — The Dark Elf Age: 23 Race: Dark Elf Occupation: Model Employer: Species-inclusive fashion magazine, MONST Bio: Abandoned by her family as a baby, Anna was named and raised by the human farmers who found her crying in the forest. Though she grew up with human values she never felt like she truly belonged. Her above average height and exotic complexion made her stand out in the village. Anna moved to the city in search of other dark elves and decided to come on the show as a last-ditch effort to find any information about her life before adoption. Interests / Hobbies: Shopping for clothes and haggling. Going to the spa and getting a massage. Hiking and nature trails. Nothing too strenuous though. Religiously keeping her skin moisturized and looking flawless. Crafting jewelry that incorporates elements from Dark Elf aesthetics.

items.name: Korelin Bottleguard
items.text: Korelin Bottleguard — The Dwarf Age: 24 Race: Dwarf Occupation: Mechanic Employer: Tregaron Dwarven Auto Body Bio: Korelin is the youngest daughter in a long lineage of alcohol-loving Bottleguard mechanics. She can easily drink more than creatures three or four times her size. She is often the first to enter a bar and is usually the last to be tossed out. Korelin enjoys drinking beer, wine, spirits, and basically anything with alcohol in it. She is often found at the local pub once her shift is finished or passed out drunk on the bench outside her workshop. Interests / Hobbies: Drinking. Duh. Betting on who can out-drink who and surprising people with her tolerance for alcohol. Turkey legs or chicken wings. Sometimes deep-fried depending on her level of inebriety. Drag racing and winning various inner city car races.

items.name: Rosamund Galbassi
items.text: Rosamund Galbassi — The Monopod Age: 28 Race: Monopod Occupation: Foot Model Employer: Big Magazine Bio: Monopods are very fast despite only having one leg. They are also extremely stable due to the weight of their foot making their center of gravity much lower. By jumping forward foot first, Rosamund can use the large weight of the foot like a swing which propels them forward into their next step. Rosamund works as a foot model for plus sized footwear for large creatures. They came on the show to find a partner who can wear the other shoe so they can purchase pairs of human shoes for cheaper. Interests / Hobbies: Cosplay. Especially really creative ones involving only one leg like a table lamp, a table football player, amongst others. Shopping for shoes and colorful socks. Racing with other creatures. Karate. Compiling data on various running related metrics and running experiments to improve running technique.

items.name: Robin Stringsworth
items.text: Robin Stringsworth — The Talking Puppet Age: 20 Race: Talking Puppet Occupation: Waitress Employer: La Criada Café Bio: Robin comes from a family of magical puppets that a mysterious wizard gave life to. Nobody knows who the wizard is. But family legends say that the wizard always had a handmade wooden pipe in his mouth. Talking Puppets do not require any water or food to live and therefore cannot gain or lose weight. Likewise, they cannot grow older in age. The Stringsworth family instead uses wood varnish to keep their body parts looking shiny. Interests / Hobbies: Dressing up in goth lolita fashion. Swapping clothes with other people. Has a large wardrobe full of random articles of clothing from different eras. Humming and whistling. Particularly at work when nobody is around. Floating in the water without any floatation devices.

items.name: Dorpip Wadlezedle
items.text: Dorpip Wadlezedle — The Gnome Age: 23 Race: Gnome Occupation: Comedian Employer: Self-employed Bio: With a surname like Wadlezedle, Dorpip believes that he was born to be a comedian. However, his family of engineers and inventors disagree wholeheartedly and look upon him as the black sheep of the family. Dorpip takes practically every opportunity he can get to crack a joke. Sometimes even at the cost of the relationships in his life. He doesn't know when to stop or turn off the joking. He dresses like a garden Gnome as a part of his comedy act. Interests / Hobbies: Making everyone laugh. Sometimes at the expense of himself. Dispelling awkward tensions with jokes. Especially fart jokes. Likes instant gratification. Cannot wait for anything for longer than 5 minutes. Crafting miniature wooden Gnomes to leave in random public places.

items.name: Gingernuts Goodyhug
items.text: Gingernuts Goodyhug — The Gingerbread Being Age: 25 Race: Gingerbread Being Occupation: Part-timer Employer: 6-Ten Convenience Bio: Gingerbread Beings need to constantly change their body parts with new cookie limbs to avoid rotting. Legend says that Gingerbread Beings were made by magical witches who were really into baking and getting a sugar high off pixie dust. Gingernuts always has a light dust of white powdered sugar underneath his nose. He sometimes eats parts of his own body when there are no other options available as a last-ditch effort. Interests / Hobbies: Stealing sugary food from work or from other people. Eating the snacks left behind at movie theaters. Sitting inside open candy boxes and jumping out to scare people. Hosting underground dance events in abandoned bakeries.

items.name: Bizz Hagglefeet
items.text: Bizz Hagglefeet — The Goblin Age: 15 Race: Goblin Occupation: Banker Employer: Bank of New Cresthill Bio: Goblins reach adulthood and physical maturity around age 8. They are named after their accomplishments in fields such as economics or con-artistry. Bizz earned his after achieving what nobody in his village could—haggle the literal feet off of a vendor. Bizz always wears a bow tie even on his worst days. He is really good with numbers and even better with people. He doesn't need a calculator for even the most complex of calculations. Bizz has an excellent memory and can recite anyone's birthday after hearing it just once, even many years later. Interests / Hobbies: Calculus. Has a strange obsession with watching pickup artist videos. Solving memory games, IQ quizzes, or online riddles. Cuddling with small furry animals. Vegetarianism. Crafting miniature furniture.

items.name: Grodrot, The Hungry
items.text: Grodrot, The Hungry — The Wyvern Age: 65 Race: Wyvern Occupation: Chef Employer: L'oeuf Restaurant Bio: Wyverns reach adulthood around age 60 and only have two legs as opposed to the four of the Dragon. Despite that, flying costs a great deal of energy. Therefore, Grodrot is always hungry and can often be found snacking on something. Grodrot attended culinary school in France and specializes in dishes based on smoking or charring foods (despite Wyverns not being able to breathe fire). He wants to share the culinary culture of Wyverns with the world. Interests / Hobbies: Taking photos of food. Scaring people by silently swooping down on them. Eating forbidden foods—especially food that has gained consciousness. Eating meat. Cannot stand the thought of eating vegetables. Participating in underground cooking competitions for honor.

items.name: Nycolas O'Sullivan
items.text: Nycolas O'Sullivan — The Dullahan Age: 21 Race: Dullahan Occupation: Jockey Employer: O'Sullivan Farms Bio: Nycolas rode horses for as long as he could remember. It's probably because he rode horses in his previous life as a human before becoming a Dullahan. When a Dullahan's head is disconnected from the body, there is a faint glow that comes out of the neck. He often carries his own head in his left hand. Nycolas lives on a farm raising purebred horses specifically for racing. He loves competition and cannot stand losing no matter how trivial. He is a sore loser. Interests / Hobbies: Taking care of animals. Particularly larger ones like horses or cows. Soaking in the tub and practicing good skin care regimen after a day's hard work. Playing darts, shooting arrows, throwing axes. Anything that requires good accuracy. Harvesting edible berries and nuts from nature.

items.name: Arya Jensen
items.text: Arya Jensen — The Sea Monk Age: 29 Race: Sea Monk Occupation: Minister Employer: Church of the New New World Bio: Arya grew up in a small remote religious town in Denmark full of other devout Sea Monks and worshipped higher beings since childhood. Arya was chosen by the village to act as a cultural emissary to the rest of the world—to spread the good word of the Sea Monks and to shed light on their isolated society. Arya was born into the Church life and wants to spread the good word to the rest of the world. Arya understands that not everyone is religious or believes in the same things, but truly wants to understand the deeper connections that bind everyone together. Interests / Hobbies: Fishing for sport. Catch and release only. Making candles with various scents using freshly picked herbs from the forest. Going on walks. Particularly by the ocean. Playing small handheld instruments like the ocarina, flute, miniature harp, the lute, and more. Building miniature ships in bottles.

items.name: Seji Toomin
items.text: Seji Toomin — The Troll Age: 26 Race: Troll Occupation: Lawyer Employer: WT&T Associates Bio: Seji is a Mountain Rock Troll of the Toomin tribe, a nomadic tribe that moves from mountain to mountain. A primitive tribe that practices the belief of "simple living" and "living without waste." Seji moved to the city at a young age to study for and pass the bar exam. Seji always wanted to prove to the world that Trolls are not as dumb as stereotypes would have you believe. Seji often wears glasses with a string strap for convenience—so as to have them ready at a moment's notice, especially during court hearings. Interests / Hobbies: Doing pro-bono work for underrepresented Mountain Trolls. Reading unique and interesting cases. Especially inter-species cases. Reading cheap romance novels while commuting or for leisure. Learning how to play the family heirloom harmonica. Adjusting the feng shui in every room.

items.name: Dommy Domination Armor Set
items.text: "Dommy" Domination Armor Set — The Sentient Armor Age: ??? Race: Sentient Armor Occupation: Security Guard Employer: Yicoran Bank Bio: "Dommy" was enchanted by a witch and brought to life many centuries ago. Countless knights have worn this armor and yet nothing is known about its origins. Thanks to the enchantment, Dommy can also speak many languages. Lost the left hand piece of the armor set a long time ago in a fierce battle. Emancipated several decades ago due to the Sentient Object Protections Act (SOPA), "Dommy" is still desperately searching for the witch behind the enchantment. Came onto the show in hopes of finding any leads. Interests / Hobbies: Scaring innocent people by pretending to be medieval decoration. Watching paint dry, grass grow, and ice melt. Anything that happens really slowly over a long period of time. Rubbing rust remover all over the armor, getting at all the nooks and crannies. Listening to brass instruments. Listening to heavy metal music.

items.name: Soh
items.text: Soh — The Unicorn Age: 24 Race: Unicorn Occupation: Printer Employer: Unicorn Graphics Bio: Soh is the youngest in a large family of 7 children. He is 19 years apart from the eldest sibling so he grew up relatively isolated and lonely. He is very entrepreneurial in spirit but doesn't enjoy working with (or for) others. Always had a very headstrong vibe to him since birth. He recently inherited the family business of printing and is trying his best to revitalize the dying industry by creating unique ways to print on magical materials. He doesn't want his family legacy to die in his hooves. Came onto the show in hopes of revitalizing his family business. Interests / Hobbies: Collecting wooden typefaces that are used for the printing press. Filming and cataloging the typefaces. Creating vlogs about the typefaces. Cooking and learning different cuisines from other cultures. Critiquing really fancy five-star restaurants.

items.name: Brigit Ní Colla
items.text: Brigit Ní Colla — The Leprechaun Age: 22 Race: Leprechaun Occupation: Bank Teller / Model Employer: Bank O'Rainbows / Clover Modeling Agency Bio: Female Leprechauns are extremely rare to the point of basically not existing. Therefore Brigit is extremely popular and is often surrounded by male peers trying to woo her. Growing up with that much attention has gone to her head, but she is learning that not everyone outside the Leprechaun community cares about the rarity of female Leprechauns. She has never had to work hard in her entire life and often had many things handed to her. She got her current day job from a family friend and was also scouted by a modeling agency on the street. Interests / Hobbies: Photography. Both taking photos and getting photos taken of. Finding cool new bars to take photos at and drinking icy cold beer. Glamping. Cannot sleep in a tent without a portable air conditioner. Creating and tasting themed cocktails for parties.

items.name: Hansan Snekker, the Wise
items.text: Hansan Snekker, the Wise — The Wizard Age: 31 Race: Human Occupation: Wizard Employer: Self-employed Bio: Hansan graduated from the prestigious Dumarth Academy of Wizarding. He works out of his workshop and runs a small consulting gig where he solves problems that only magic can solve. He rarely uses potions, preferring instead to cast ancient spells. He is also really into woodworking when not doing magical things and likes to take time off from magical work to build things with just his bare hands. Although sometimes he has to cheat and use a spell or two to fix his woodworking mistakes. Interests / Hobbies: Woodworking, whittling, and carpentry. Antique guns and firearms. Gardening. Strives to grow food without the use of magic but sometimes is forced to use spells to save any dying plants. Collecting various keyboards and keycaps. Sometimes also makes his own. Creating wooden bird houses that are bigger on the inside than on the outside.

items.name: Sysife Bernard
items.text: Sysife Bernard — The Bicorn Age: 26 Race: Bicorn Occupation: Artist Employer: Self-employed Bio: Sysife was born in Western France but moved around the world a lot as a child and can therefore speak many languages. Not a lot is known about the Bicorn and, due to their scary appearance, they are often feared wherever they go. Sysife came on the show to dispel false rumors surrounding Bicorns and to improve their public perception. Sysife used to work for a large corporation as just another cog in the machine. Ultimately decided to quit the life of an office drone to pursue freelance illustration and to shake up the status quo in the modern art world. Interests / Hobbies: Karaoke. Particularly songs that have been translated into many languages. Making art by drawing shapes in a complex sequence or pattern. Painting using clashing bold strokes of vibrant colors. Making a statement using art. Running. Particularly by the ocean. Making custom rubber ducks.

items.name: Elias & Maya Dimakos
items.text: Elias & Maya Dimakos — The Gemini Age: 25 Race: Gemini Occupation: Freelance Artist / Accountant Employer: Self-employed / Better Calculations Business Bio: Gemini have two brains but share one body. They can often read the mind of the other. Usually the two individual personalities are quite similar but there have been rare cases of them being vastly different. Elias is more creative and spontaneous while Maya is more calculating and enjoys planning things out far into the future. Together they are a great match for each other and are literally inseparable. They host a weekly podcast where they invite various guests to talk about their unique problems. Interests / Hobbies: Drawing comics and creating short meme clips for social media (Elias). Solving cross-word puzzles, logic puzzles, and daily word riddles (Maya). Playing various instruments together at the same time as a "one-body" band. Marketing their podcast on various social media platforms.

items.name: Susom
items.text: Susom — The Giant Age: 50 Race: Giant Occupation: Construction Worker Employer: Onyx Construction & Demolition Bio: Giants reach adulthood around age 50. Giants don't have surnames because they are so big they don't need a surname to further specify who they are. Everybody knows their local neighborhood Giant. Susom is very shy despite her stature and size. She always wanted a surname to fit in with the rest of the world. She doesn't like standing out in a crowd or being picked for anything. She is a people pleaser and wants to be accepted by a group. She prefers to wear very simple loose-fitting clothing without any intricate designs or patterns. Interests / Hobbies: People watching. Particularly from a hidden angle or location. Sitting outside in the rain and letting the water wash away the stresses of life. Primitive camping. Bushcraft. Surviving in nature with minimal tools or technology. Creating miniature models of the town and residents to-scale.
